history_summary: Record nine GTDB species-reference correspondences for the distinct LaCa SynCom C inoculum stocks.
history_details: The exact pinned crosswalk supports seven exact NCBI-ID species routes and two NCBI-name fallback routes for the nine separately preserved LaCa inoculum descriptors. Native reference totals and fractions are Se C 5694/1.0, Sc C 391/1.0, Ml C 236/0.95, Ct C 36/1.0, Cv C 96/0.99, Cc C 3654/1.0, Cg C 215/1.0, Ao C 28/1.0 and Ph C 2/1.0, where each pair means total reference genomes and majority fraction, not an explicit support numerator. Ct C uses the species-name route to Corynebacterium tuberculostearicum_C and Ph C to Peptoniphilus_A harei_A; their original unsuffixed NCBI/source names and stock identifiers remain unchanged. No reference result identifies an experimental stock genome, assembly, abundance, phenotype or persistence. The nine inoculum stocks remain distinct from the two excluded Staphylococcus aureus challenge rows in the separate supplement. Only nine correspondence blocks/statuses and two native inline events changed. All source quotations, donor and strain notes, experimental boundaries, empty interaction graph, biological content and previous history remain unchanged. The outstanding all-nine-persistence and proposed-tyrosine-mechanism limitations documented under issue 1640 remain unresolved; no causal or functional claim is added. The retained preprint and separate supplementary text remain distinct sources, and latest publication status is unverified. The crosswalk hash identifies exact bytes without an established release or chronology. This partial technical correspondence diagnostic does not complete scientific review, generated products or aggregate QC.
